Job Summary
PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Collection Officer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for gathering, verifying, and inputting critical operational and market data to support our agribusiness decision-making processes. You will ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of data from various field and internal sources to facilitate efficient reporting and strategic planning.

Job Responsibilities
* Collect, compile, and systematically organize operational, production, and market data from various departments and field locations.
* Conduct regular field visits and coordinate with site supervisors to gather accurate raw data.
* Verify the accuracy and consistency of collected data, identifying and correcting any discrepancies or errors.
* Input data into the company’s database systems promptly and maintain organized digital and physical archives.
* Assist in generating routine reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for management review.
* Collaborate with the IT and analytics teams to improve data collection methods, tools, and database efficiency.
* Ensure strict adherence to company data security, privacy policies, and standard operating procedures.

Job Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Information Technology, Agribusiness, Economics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in data collection, data entry, or a similar administrative/analytical role, preferably within the agribusiness or manufacturing industry.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and experience with database management systems.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate effectively with diverse team members across different locations.
* Willingness to travel to various company sites and field operations as required.
